dialogues.speaker: Bossuet
dialogues.text: Oh, right. I'm working on tonight's menu. After much contemplation, I decided on fish for the main dish, to go with a few special drinks...

dialogues.speaker: Bossuet
dialogues.text: I'm sure those gentlemen will be pleased.

dialogues.speaker: Bossuet
dialogues.text: Thanks to the God King's grace, the spices I ordered finally arrived on time, and combined with some fish fresh from the ocean...

dialogues.speaker: Bossuet
dialogues.text: Well, feel free to stay and have a taste! Trust me, fish are my specialty!
